subject.title: fix(reef): discover trusted peers as conversations

question: Must this PR demonstrate the trusted-peer list and first correlated turn in a real two-peer Reef setup before merge, or may the proof gate be explicitly overridden and validated after deployment?
rationale: The PR intentionally defers its only real-runtime proof until after landing, while the change affects cross-process delivery and persisted session association that tests and CI cannot fully establish.

options.title: Require live proof before merge
options.body: Rebase the branch and provide a redacted two-peer run showing discovery before any session, a successful turn in both directions, and one canonical session binding.

options.title: Explicitly override the proof gate
options.body: A maintainer may accept the tested implementation and own post-deployment validation plus any resulting rollback or follow-up.

recommendation.title: Require live proof before merge
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch and provide a redacted two-peer run showing discovery before any session, a successful turn in both directions, and one canonical session binding.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history and current self-assignment make this the strongest available owner for the proof-versus-release decision.
